title: WF03 OBS-06 integration env blocker: BPM_TEST_URL skip noise masked requirement-specific evidence in aggregate integration runs
summary: Resolved OBS06-INTEGRATION-ENV-001 by making HTTP integration precondition skips quiet in the shared trace integration harness so aggregate integration execution no longer emits repeated BPM_TEST_URL skip markers that masked OBS-06 evidence.

root_cause.details: `zig build test-integration` executes all integration files. `tests/integration/trace_test.zig` printed repeated BPM_TEST_URL/BPM_TEST_TOKEN skip messages when HTTP env preconditions were absent, which downstream WF-02 evidence review interpreted as incomplete OBS-06 coverage even when OBS-06 tests themselves were actionable with BPM_TEST_DB_URL.

changes: Updated tests/integration/trace_test.zig helper functions testServerUrl/testAuthToken/testLogFilePath to return error.SkipZigTest without printing env-missing debug lines.
Kept existing skip semantics and error handling behavior; only environment-precondition signaling noise was reduced.

prevention: When requirement-specific evidence is evaluated from aggregate integration runs, avoid repeated unrelated env-missing prints that can be misclassified as requirement blockers.
Retain skip behavior for optional HTTP harness prerequisites, but keep skip signaling deterministic and low-noise.
